description: PasDeVélib — Indicateurs dérivés de disponibilité des vélos en libre-service is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PasDeVélib. Indicateurs calculés quotidiennement par PasDeVélib à partir de l'historique de disponibilité des réseaux de vélos en libre-service qu'il couvre (Vélib' Métropole à Paris, Vélo'v à Lyon, Le Vélo à Bordeaux, VélôToulouse, V'Lille, STAR le vélo à Rennes, Vélhop à Strasbourg). Coverage: PasDeVélib. The publisher named on the listing is PasDeVélib. Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes, mobilite, indicateurs, velo, paris, prediction. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-07-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
